verdicts.reason: Quote states AXI address equals accepted AHB address; checkable.
Width definition only; fixed signal widths, nothing dynamic to verify beyond the declaration.
Quote says bridge does not byte-swap; checkable data equality.
Size encoding stated; checkable AxSIZE vs HSIZE mapping.
Rejection of larger sizes is stated; it is a scenario to exercise (error response), and should be checked by scenario; strength and check ok except actor is the bridge, fine. Check stays scenario.
Strobe passed per beat; checkable HWSTRB to WSTRB.
Endian statement is redundant with no byte-swap and not independently checkable; only says interpretation belongs to the system.
LEN = beats minus one stated; checkable.
Aggregated write burst LEN 3, 7 or 15 stated.
Describes the ID type/width only; nothing to verify beyond the declaration.
Independent per-direction ID rotation stated; needs scenario of mixed traffic.

duplicates.reason: Both state no byte-swap/endian conversion of data by the bridge.
Single-beat LEN=0 is a special case of LEN = beats minus one.

questions.question: Is the ID rotation count configurable, and what is the rotation order and wrap behavior? The quote does not define it.
How are oversize transfers rejected (which response, is anything forwarded to AXI)?
After boundary split, what are the AWLEN values of the split bursts? Only pre-split lengths are given.
